name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_chronic_lung_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of chronic lung disease.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of chronic lung disease.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of chronic lung disease.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of chronic lung disease.

name: patient_has_exacerbation_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently experiencing an exacerbation.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently experiencing an exacerbation.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not experiencing an exacerbation.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently experiencing an exacerbation.

name: patient_is_in_clinical_validation_group
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is a member of the Clinical Validation group.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is a member of the Clinical Validation group.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not a member of the Clinical Validation group.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is a member of the Clinical Validation group.

name: patient_is_in_clinical_validation_group@@in_groups_other_than_clinical_validation_group
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is in groups other than the Clinical Validation group.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is in groups other than the Clinical Validation group.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not in groups other than the Clinical Validation group (i.e., is in the Clinical Validation group only).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is in groups other than the Clinical Validation group.

name: patient_is_undergoing_computed_tomography_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently undergoing a computed tomography (CT) scan.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing a computed tomography (CT) scan.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not undergoing a computed tomography (CT) scan.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently undergoing a computed tomography (CT) scan.

name: patient_is_undergoing_computed_tomography_now@@at_time_of_exacerbation
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the computed tomography (CT) scan is occurring at the time of an exacerbation.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing a computed tomography (CT) scan and this scan is occurring at the time of an exacerbation.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently undergoing a computed tomography (CT) scan but not at the time of an exacerbation, or if the scan is not occurring.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the CT scan is occurring at the time of an exacerbation.

name: patient_is_undergoing_physical_examination_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently undergoing a clinical (physical) examination.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing a clinical (physical) examination.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not undergoing a clinical (physical) examination.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently undergoing a clinical (physical) examination.

name: patient_is_undergoing_physical_examination_now@@at_time_of_exacerbation
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the clinical (physical) examination is occurring at the time of an exacerbation.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing a clinical (physical) examination and this examination is occurring at the time of an exacerbation.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently undergoing a clinical (physical) examination but not at the time of an exacerbation, or if the examination is not occurring.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the clinical examination is occurring at the time of an exacerbation.
